money._note: Money safety round 2 (2026-09-29, money/). Raising or removing a Mobile Money limit waits coolingOffMs (lowering is immediate) so a caller can't talk the user into lifting it and sending at once; MTN's 'You have sent' message within receiptWindowMs of a PIN hand-off is read as a receipt.

flow._note: Finance audit (2026-10-01, money/MoneyFlow): a spoken send / airtime / balance / 'did it go through' is planned on the phone, before any model. enabled=false restores the older on-phone rules; airtime=false keeps airtime on the older mobile_money route (the menu is opened and the planner walks it).

outcome._note: money/TxLedger: a hand-off at the PIN is settled by the network's own message within windowMs (else it is 'not known'); the same amount to the same number inside repeatMs is flagged in the read-back; followUpMs after the hand-off the inbox is looked at once more and silence is said; speak=false keeps the outcome for 'did my payment go through' only.
